extracted.intended_audience: authors and editors of Cochrane systematic reviews (review teams preparing/maintaining intervention reviews)
extracted.subtask_description: Authoritative methodological guidance for preparing and maintaining Cochrane systematic reviews of healthcare interventions, covering standard methods (planning, searching, data collection, analysis, GRADE) and specialised topics (non-randomized studies, adverse effects, equity, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbook as the official guide
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions is the official guide that describes in detail the process of preparing and maintaining Cochrane systematic reviews on the effects of healthcare interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All authors should consult the Handbook for guidance on the methods used in Cochrane systematic reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on planning a review is included as a standard method applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers core planning tasks authors must follow when preparing a Cochrane review (protocol, objectives, eligibility, outcomes, etc. — see relevant Handbook chapters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Searching and selecting studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Handbook guidance covers searching and selecting studies as a standard method applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes expectations for comprehensive search strategies and transparent study selection processes (see Handbook chapters linked from MECIR items).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on data collection is included among the standard methods applicable to every review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how to collect and manage study data for synthesis (extraction templates, double extraction, data verification — see Handbook).

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk of bias assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Handbook provides guidance on assessing risk of bias for studies included in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers tools and approaches for judging bias and incorporating those assessments into interpretation of results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical analysis methods for synthesising data are covered as standard Handbook guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes guidance on meta-analysis methods, model choices, heterogeneity assessment, and sensitivity analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: GRADE and interpreting results
rubrics_metrics.description: Handbook guidance includes use of GRADE and principles for interpreting review results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses rating certainty of evidence, presenting summary of findings, and interpreting clinical and policy implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-randomized studies (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook includes specialised guidance for handling non-randomized studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers methodological considerations distinct from randomized trials (design-specific biases, confounding, synthesis methods).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse effects (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on assessing and reporting adverse effects is included as a specialised topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses searching for, extracting, and interpreting harms data and balancing benefits and harms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complex interventions (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook covers methodological issues specific to complex interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes considerations for intervention components, implementation variability, and appropriate synthesis approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on equity considerations in systematic reviews is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how to consider and report effects across disadvantaged or equity-relevant groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economics (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook includes guidance on economic evidence relevant to intervention reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers when and how to incorporate cost and economic evaluation data into reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-reported outcomes (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on patient-reported outcomes is included as a specialised topic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers selection, measurement, and interpretation of PROs in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual patient data (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook provides methodological guidance for reviews using individual patient data (IPD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses IPD collection, harmonisation, and analysis considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prospective meta-analysis (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for conducting prospective meta-analyses is included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers planning, coordination, and analysis issues specific to prospective pooling of studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative research (specialised topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Handbook includes guidance on qualitative research relevant to reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses integration of qualitative evidence, methods for synthesis, and implications for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Key aspects of Handbook guidance are collated as the Methodological Expectations for Cochrane Intervention Reviews (MECIR), which provide core standards generally expected of Cochrane reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each MECIR item includes a link to a relevant Handbook chapter; MECIR items act as core standards reviewers are expected to meet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citing the Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for how to cite the full Handbook online and the print edition are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific citation formats are given for the online version (version 6.5, updated August 2024) and the 2nd edition print version; chapter-level citation details are available in each chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission to re-use Handbook material
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on academic/non-commercial and commercial reuse of Handbook material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short quotations may be used without permission if appropriately cited; reproduction of figures/tables/lengthy quotations requires filling a permission request form. Commercial reuse inquiries should go to Wiley Global Permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version history and updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Details on how the Handbook has changed and the process for updating the Handbook are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Archived copies of previous versions are listed (versions 4.x–6.4) and a Versions and changes page explains differences and update process.
